python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test R3: Compare with string should return NotImplemented (and thus fail comparisons)
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('Equals string:', v == '1.2.3')
print('Not equals string:', v != '1.2.3')
print('Less than string:', v < '1.2.3')
print('Greater than string:', v > '1.2.3')

# Test with integer
print('Equals int:', v == 1)
print('Not equals int:', v != 1)
"
